title: Vegetation Browning Beyond Climatic Drought: Agro-Climatic Trend, Rainfall Decoupling and Land-Change Evidence in Northern Nigeria
key_result: The LGP 180–239 day agro-climatic stratum shows statistically significant vegetation decline without statistically significant rainfall decline; independent land-change evidence supports an interpretation more consistent with land-use and vegetation-cover change than climatic drought alone.
